text:
Kori (Growth): Hey team — need a compact "snackable" asset bundle for next week's benchmark webinar and the post-launch email. Short timeline: assets by EOD Wed. Can design own or reuse elements from the benchmark kit. :clock1:

Riley (Design): Got it. Can you scope what "snackable" means here? Variants / sizes? :eyes:

Kori (Growth): Short list: social cards (carousel + single image), one email hero, 3 tweet-length copy variations, and quick GIF/microtile for the top of the webinar landing. Keep everything brand-compliant. Also need A/B copy variants for subject lines and primary CTA. :memo:

Maya P.: Also need clarity on which model/benchmark stat to surface — attendees care about latency & token cost. If we highlight a single stat, prefer "avg inference latency" and a short cost-savings blurb.

Kori (Growth): Good call — surface: "avg latency: 42ms (per-token)", and "~2x cheaper vs typical baseline" as a short subline. Use short phrasing for socials.

Riley (Design): Ok. Draft plan: 1) 4 social card sizes: 1200x628 (LinkedIn), 1080x1080 (IG/Twitter), 1080x1920 (Stories), 1200x675 (X/Twitter wide). 2) Email hero 1200x400. 3) GIF microtile 600x600, 3s loop. 4) 3 subject line options + 3 CTA copy options. 5) PNG + SVG exports + Figma file.

Riley (Design): Quick spec block (for assets-bot and devs):
```
Assets needed:
- social-static: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 1080x1920, 1200x675 (png + svg)
- email-hero: 1200x400 (png, svg)
- microtile-gif: 600x600, 3s loop (mp4 + gif)
- copy: csv with short copy (<= 280 chars for tweets), subject lines, CTA variants
- export naming: benchmark-snapshot-YYYYMMDD-<asset>-v1.{png,svg,gif,mp4}
- deliverable: Figma link + exports + README with color & font tokens
```

Sam O.: Quick ask re: brand — use primary blue + neutral overlays; don't use the neon variant from the internal sketch. Can we get a 1px safe margin for token overlays?

Leo (Design Ops): Re naming + handoff: we'll need layer naming conventions in Figma and separate component instances for each size (so marketing can update copy after handoff). Also include an accessibility check: contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text.

Kori (Growth): Timeline reminder: live announcement scheduled Thu 9am PT. So Wed EOD handoff preferred. If any blocker, escalate to me asap.

Riley (Design): Understood. I'll do a quick wireframe today and post a Figma link for review. Expect 2 rounds: initial comps by Tue afternoon, final by Wed EOD.

assets-bot: Uploaded placeholder board — https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/benchmark-snack-pack. Use as working file. :rocket:

Maya P.: For copy A/B testing — short subject examples: 1) "New inference benchmarks: faster + cheaper" 2) "How we cut avg latency by 2x" 3) "Benchmark highlights: speed & cost" — will adapt tone for social.

Kori (Growth): Perfect. For CTAs prefer: [Explore the report], [See pricing & perf], [Watch the short demo]. We'll pick final at handoff.

Riley (Design): Noted. I'll post the initial comps in the thread and tag @Kori @Maya @Sam for copy+brand sync. If anyone wants a different stat pulled in, shout now.

Sam O.: One small ask — include export preset for 1x and 2x (retina) for PNGs. Also add a plain-white background variant for press reuse.

Riley (Design): Will do.

Kori (Growth): Thanks all — please keep replies short in-thread. If design needs more time, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
